description: This file defines the HomeFragment class, which implements the main home screen for an Android TV application. It constructs a UI featuring a top navigation bar with categories including a search icon, a styled brand label, and multiple content rails displaying horizontally scrollable lists of content items. The class handles view initialization, focus management for D-pad navigation, styling of UI elements, and mock data setup for content displays.

classes.name: ContentItem
classes.description: Represents a media content item with id, title, and image URL.

classes.name: ContentRow
classes.description: Represents a row of content items with a title and list of ContentItems.

classes.name: MockContentData
classes.description: Provides mock data generation for ContentItems used in the content rails.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the Fragment's view hierarchy using view binding.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the UI components: brand text, top navigation, and content rails.

methods.name: setupBrand
methods.description: Styles the brand label with specific color ranges and accessibility labels.

methods.name: setupTopNav
methods.description: Initializes the horizontal top navigation bar with categories, including a search icon, and manages focus behavior.

methods.name: setupContentRails
methods.description: Creates mock data and sets up the vertical list of content rows with horizontal scrolling content.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Clears view binding references to prevent memory leaks.
